note: REQ-0185. A dungeon def is authored, PROBABILITY-WEIGHTED references to monster_pack defs (packs.json) and gimic defs (gimics.json) -- the user ruling 2026-07-17: dungeonは、gimicとmonster_packを確率参照して、設定してください. At dive time the server ROLLS a concrete encounter list from these weighted tables (sim/dungeon_roll.cjs), deterministically given a seed; there is NO runtime dungeon-graph generation. The def inlines NOTHING: packs live in packs.json, gimics in gimics.json, referenced by id. Level scales only the COUNTS (packEncounters/gimicSlots), monotonically; enemy strength is the authored pack (unchanged from the pilot). The only gimics authored today are the four frost interactables (gimics.json), so every dungeon references them for now -- per-theme gimic content is a follow-up (see REQ-0185).
